bootstrap.note: Salt-bridge formation uses a true protein-level resample (30 test proteins, G73/G96 method with a numpy average_precision_score verified to agree with sklearn to 1e-12). The other three phenomena have only 2 test proteins, so only 3 resample combinations exist and the bootstrap distribution takes only 3 distinct values; the 10,000 draws are mapped onto the 3 exact combination values (G23 method).
